row.name: Jedi Equipped
row.description: Gift from the Order; includes Lightsaber Construction at IQ level.

row.name: Old Republic Patriot
row.description: You are a staunch believer in the ideals of the Republic, even as its bureaucracy and military struggles are laid bare by the war. You may salute Republic soldiers or speak fondly of Coruscant.

row.name: Force Jump/Leap
row.description: The Force-user enhances their physical jump or leap through an application of the Force.
row.effect: Double your effective Jumping skill distance.

row.name: Force Push/Pull
row.description: The Force-user can telekinetically push or pull objects and beings.
row.effect: Exert a telekinetic force equal to your Basic Lift (BL) on objects within 10 feet. Cannot inflict damage directly.

row.name: Jedi Robes (Cloak)
row.notes: Part of Jedi Robes Ensemble. Includes a hood.
row.effects: Part of the Jedi Robes Ensemble; +1 FP even without the rest. Usually tan, cream or brown -- color is the player’s choice.
